title: Reports

loadFailed.title: The report could not be loaded.

loadFailed.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
loadFailed.server: The backend failed while building the report. Retry; if it keeps failing, check the backend log.

ignored.unknownPeriod: Ignored an unknown period; showing the last 7 days.

empty.text: No alerts or anomalies were opened in this period.

forbidden: You need the {permission} permission to see this block. The other blocks are not affected.
blockFailed: This block could not be read: its query failed, so nothing is shown rather than a zero. Retry the report; the other blocks are not affected.
blockUnknown: This block could not be measured (reason {code}). Nothing is shown rather than a zero.
blockNoReason: This block could not be measured. Nothing is shown rather than a zero.
otherHint: No alert family claims these source types, so the list cannot be filtered to them.
